articles.title: Bike Rider Narrowly Escapes After Falling Into Sudden Pothole in Gandhinagar
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Gujarat)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A biker narrowly escaped serious injury after falling into a large pothole that suddenly appeared on a road in Kudasan, Gandhinagar. CCTV captured the crash. Wearing a helmet may have prevented worse injuries. Questions are now being raised over road quality.

body.html:
A young bike rider narrowly escaped serious injury after falling into a large pothole that suddenly appeared on a road in Kudasan, Gandhinagar, Gujarat.

CCTV footage of the incident has surfaced, showing the rider losing control and falling into the deep pothole.

According to reports, the rider was wearing a helmet, which may have helped prevent more serious injuries. Fortunately, no vehicle was approaching from behind at the time, potentially avoiding a more serious accident.

The sudden appearance of a large pothole on a road reportedly being constructed at a cost of crores of rupees has raised questions over the quality of construction and road maintenance.

The incident has also drawn attention to Gujarat's growing pothole problem, coming just a day after the Gujarat Chief Minister reportedly reprimanded officials over the condition of roads.

The CCTV footage has further intensified calls for accountability and proper inspection of road construction and maintenance work.

articles.title: Film Producer’s Car Allegedly Runs Over Woman in Hyderabad, Driver Booked
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Telangana)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: The victim, identified as Sunitha
articles.excerpt: A woman was injured after a car allegedly ran over her while she walked on Chapel Road in Abids, Hyderabad. Sunitha, an SBI bank housekeeper, reportedly suffered a leg fracture. Police registered a case and are investigating.

body.html:
A woman was injured after a car allegedly ran over her while she was walking along the road in Abids, Hyderabad, on Wednesday, August 12.

The victim, identified as Sunitha, a resident of Andalamma Basti in Nampally, reportedly works as a housekeeper at the SBI Bank in Gun Foundry. She was returning home after work when the incident occurred on Chapel Road.

According to reports, the car, allegedly driven by Mahananda, the driver of film producer Bommaku Murali, was travelling at speed when it struck Sunitha. The vehicle reportedly ran over her leg, leaving her with a fracture.

Sunitha was taken to a hospital for treatment.

Her family members reportedly contacted the car owner seeking financial assistance for her medical expenses. Following the dispute, the family approached the police and lodged a complaint.

Police have registered a case and are investigating the circumstances of the accident, including the allegations regarding the vehicle and its driver.

The incident has also renewed concerns among local residents about poorly maintained and encroached footpaths in Hyderabad, which often force pedestrians to walk on busy roads. Residents have called for the removal of encroachments and improved pedestrian infrastructure to prevent similar accidents.

articles.title: Three Women Allegedly Steal ₹9.52 Lakh in Cash and Jewellery From Gujarat Jewellery Shop
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Gujarat)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: Sanman Jewellers CCTV
articles.excerpt: Three women allegedly stole ₹9.52 lakh in cash, gold and silver jewellery from a Visnagar shop after distracting an 85-year-old man. CCTV reportedly captured the theft, including one woman appearing to pray before taking the bag. Police are investigating.

body.html:
Three unidentified women allegedly carried out a daylight theft at a jewellery shop in Visnagar, Mehsana district, Gujarat, escaping with ₹2.50 lakh in cash and gold and silver jewellery worth around ₹7.02 lakh.

According to the shop owner, the total value of the stolen valuables was approximately ₹9.52 lakh.

The incident reportedly occurred at Sanman Jewellers in the Three Tower area. The shop owner had placed a black bag containing the cash and jewellery near the safe before starting work.

Around 11.15 am, three women allegedly entered the shop on the pretext of purchasing jewellery. The shop owner was reportedly away at the time, leaving his 85-year-old father inside.

According to the complaint, the women allegedly kept the elderly man engaged by asking to see jewellery and discussing prices. While two of them reportedly distracted him, the third allegedly picked up the bag containing the valuables.

CCTV footage reportedly captured the entire incident. One of the women is also seen apparently pausing to pray before allegedly taking the bag.

The trio reportedly fled the shop with the valuables. The theft came to light after the owner returned and discovered that the bag was missing.

The shop owner subsequently approached Visnagar City Police, who registered a case and began examining CCTV footage from the shop and surrounding areas to identify and trace the suspects.

Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Finance Company Employee Allegedly Beaten by 7–8 Men in Bulandshahr, Teeth Broken
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: The victim, identified as Yogesh
articles.excerpt: A finance company collection associate in Dibai, Bulandshahr, was allegedly assaulted by seven to eight men who entered his office. The victim, Yogesh, reportedly suffered serious injuries, including broken teeth, and was allegedly threatened with death. Police are investigating.

body.html:
A collection associate working for a finance company in Dibai, Bulandshahr, was allegedly assaulted by a group of men who entered his office and attacked him.

The victim, identified as Yogesh, son of Purushottam and a resident of Jahangirabad, alleged that around seven to eight people entered the office and assaulted him. He reportedly suffered serious injuries, including broken teeth, and was allegedly threatened with death.

Following the attack, Yogesh was taken to Bulandshahr District Hospital for medical treatment.

He has demanded strict action from the Dibai police station in-charge and senior police officials. Police have reportedly assured him that appropriate action will be taken after examining the complaint and evidence.

Further details regarding the motive behind the assault and any arrests are awaited.

articles.title: Fish Dish Priced at ₹200, Billed at ₹300: Price Dispute Turns Violent at Malappuram Hotel
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Kerala)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dispute over the price of a fish dish reportedly escalated into a violent clash between customers and restaurant staff at a hotel in Kuttippuram, Malappuram. The disagreement allegedly began after a ₹200 dish was billed at ₹300, with several people reportedly injured and furniture damaged.

body.html:
A dispute over the price of a fish dish reportedly escalated into a violent clash between customers and restaurant staff at Chorum Meenum Hotel in Kuttippuram, Malappuram, Kerala.

According to reports, customers were allegedly told that a particular fish dish would cost ₹200 when it was served. However, the final bill reportedly listed the same dish at ₹300, triggering an argument between the diners and hotel employees.

The disagreement soon turned physical, with customers and staff allegedly exchanging blows inside the crowded restaurant. Several people were reportedly injured, while tables, chairs and other furniture were damaged during the confrontation.

The restaurant was reportedly crowded at the time, with customers from Malappuram and other districts present. The sudden violence allegedly caused panic among diners, including women and children, who tried to move away from the clash.

The incident has also renewed concerns over transparent food pricing. Restaurants are expected to clearly communicate applicable prices to customers, and disputes can arise when verbally quoted prices differ from the amount ultimately charged.

Further details regarding injuries, complaints and any police action are awaited.

articles.title: Two Die After Suspected Toxic Gas Exposure Inside Abandoned Toilet Pit in Kodagu
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Karnataka)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: The deceased were identified as Nithya, 46, and Janardhan, 43,
articles.excerpt: Two people died after allegedly being exposed to toxic gas inside an old, unused toilet pit in Hosathota village, Kodagu. A woman reportedly fell into the pit after it collapsed, while a man attempting to rescue her was also overcome by fumes. The exact cause is under investigation.

body.html:
Two people died after allegedly being exposed to toxic gas inside an old, unused toilet pit in Hosathota village of Somwarpet taluk, Kodagu district, on Monday evening, August 10.

The deceased were identified as Nithya, 46, and Janardhan, 43, both residents of the same village.

According to preliminary information, Nithya had gone to a relative’s agricultural field to collect ginger when an old toilet pit nearby reportedly collapsed, causing her to fall inside.

Janardhan allegedly rushed to rescue her and entered the pit. However, he was reportedly overcome by poisonous gases accumulated inside the confined space. Both were declared dead at the spot.

Local residents alerted the authorities, following which personnel from Somwarpet police station reached the village and began an investigation.

The bodies were recovered from the pit and sent to Madikeri District Hospital for post-mortem examination. Officials are awaiting medical reports to determine the exact cause of death and confirm whether toxic-gas exposure was responsible.

The incident has highlighted the dangers posed by abandoned and poorly maintained toilet pits, particularly in rural areas, where confined spaces can contain deadly gases even when no warning signs are visible.

Police are investigating the condition of the structure and whether any prior safety concerns had been reported. Further details are awaited.

articles.title: Woman Arrested in Pune for Allegedly Hurling Footwear at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Statue
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Maharashtra)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman identified as Ashwini Dagde was arrested in Pune after CCTV allegedly showed her abusing and throwing footwear and stones at a statue of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj in Hadapsar. Police are investigating the incident.

body.html:
A woman identified as Ashwini Dagde was arrested by Pune City Police after she was allegedly caught on CCTV abusing and throwing footwear and stones at a statue of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj in Sasane Nagar, Hadapsar, on August 10.

According to police and local reports, the incident triggered anger among residents, who confronted the woman and subsequently handed her over to the police. Videos circulating on social media show members of the crowd applying purple ink to her face and arms before police intervention.

The Kalepadal Police Station registered a case and initiated legal proceedings against Dagde. Police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the incident, including the alleged motive.

The incident has also sparked debate over the reaction of the crowd. While some people praised residents for intervening, others criticised the alleged public humiliation and stressed that accusations should be dealt with through due legal process rather than vigilantism.

Meanwhile, claims circulating on social media attempting to give the incident a communal angle have reportedly been found to be false. Police have confirmed that the accused woman is not Muslim.

The investigation is underway, and authorities are examining the available CCTV footage and other evidence to establish the full sequence of events.

articles.title: Retired Army Jawan Killed, 3 Injured After Speeding SUV Allegedly Hits Pedestrians in Hyderabad
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Telangana)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 55-year-old retired Army jawan was killed and three others injured after a speeding Mahindra SUV allegedly travelling on the wrong side of the road rammed into pedestrians at Hydershakote in Hyderabad. Police have detained a suspected driver and are investigating the crash.

body.html:
A 55-year-old retired Army jawan was killed on the spot and three others were injured after a speeding Mahindra SUV allegedly travelling on the wrong side of the road rammed into pedestrians at Hydershakote in Narsingi, Hyderabad, on Monday morning.

The accident occurred near SMP School at around 6 am. The deceased was identified as Ravinder, a Hydershakote resident who had served in the Army for nearly 20 years. After retiring, he was reportedly working at the Artillery Centre, Golconda.

According to his relatives, Ravinder was returning home from work and was just a few minutes away from his residence when the SUV allegedly came from the wrong side of the road and struck him with considerable force. The impact reportedly threw him into the air, causing fatal injuries.

Police said the SUV continued after hitting Ravinder and allegedly rammed into other pedestrians. Three people were injured and shifted to a nearby hospital for treatment, with one reportedly in critical condition.

The SUV allegedly had five youths inside. After the crash, the occupants reportedly abandoned the vehicle and fled the scene.

During the investigation, police reportedly found alcohol bottles inside the SUV, raising suspicion that the occupants may have consumed alcohol before the accident. Police have detained a suspected driver and are questioning him to establish who was behind the wheel at the time of the crash.

The SUV has reportedly been identified as belonging to a resident of the Shamshabad Airport area. Police are examining CCTV footage to determine the vehicle's speed and direction and establish the exact sequence of events.

The Narsingi police are continuing their investigation into the suspected rash and negligent driving and the circumstances surrounding Ravinder's death.

articles.title: Tinder Friendship Turns Into Alleged ₹6 Crore Blackmail Racket in Prayagraj; High Court Lawyer Files
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: Pallavi Singh Rajput
articles.excerpt: A woman identified as Pallavi Singh Rajput has been accused of befriending men through Tinder and social media before allegedly using intimate photos/videos to blackmail them for money. The complaint claims over ₹6 crore was extorted from multiple victims. Police are investigating.

body.html:
A woman in Uttar Pradesh’s Prayagraj has been accused of allegedly befriending men through Tinder and social media before using intimate photographs and videos to blackmail them for money.

The woman has been identified in the complaint as Pallavi Singh Rajput. According to the allegations, she allegedly established contact with men through dating apps and social-media platforms, with conversations initially developing as friendships and later becoming closer relationships.

The complainant alleges that after meeting the men, intimate photographs or videos were obtained and subsequently used to threaten them with criminal cases and public humiliation unless they paid money. The complaint claims that more than ₹6 crore was allegedly extorted from multiple victims.

Some alleged victims have claimed they were threatened with cases involving serious offences, including rape and attempted murder, if they refused to pay. The complainant further alleges that several men were jailed following cases filed against them.

The complaint also names two other women and two men as alleged associates. One of the social-media identities mentioned in the complaint is reportedly “Sweety Tiwari.”

Photographs circulating online, including images purportedly showing bundles of cash and a woman holding what appears to be a weapon, have also been linked to the allegations. However, the origin, date and context of these images have not been independently verified.

The allegations have not been established in court, and police are investigating the complaint and the claims made by the alleged victims.

The investigation will determine whether an organised extortion network operated in Prayagraj and whether the accused and others were involved.

articles.title: Wife Allegedly Plots Husband’s Murder With Lover in Muzaffarnagar; Both Arrested
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: The wife Meena, husband Naseem alias Talib and lover Asim Abbasi.
articles.excerpt: Police in Uttar Pradesh’s Muzaffarnagar have arrested a woman accused of conspiring with her alleged lover to kill her husband, 28-year-old welder Naseem alias Talib. Police allege the husband was attacked with a sharp-edged weapon after objecting to their relationship and later died.

body.html:
In a shocking murder case in Uttar Pradesh’s Muzaffarnagar, police have arrested a woman accused of conspiring with her alleged lover to kill her husband, 28-year-old welder Naseem alias Talib from Meerut.

According to police, Talib had travelled to his in-laws’ home in the Safipur Patti area of Budhana. Investigators allege that his wife, Meena, was involved in a relationship with Asim Abbasi and that the two conspired to eliminate Talib after he objected to their relationship.

Police said Asim allegedly attacked Talib with a sharp-edged weapon during a confrontation outside the house. Talib suffered multiple injuries and was rushed to hospital before being referred to Meerut for advanced treatment, where he later died.

The investigation reportedly took a major turn after police examined evidence from Meena’s mobile phone, which allegedly indicated her involvement in the suspected conspiracy. Police subsequently arrested her from her rented accommodation.

Asim was earlier arrested following an alleged police encounter on Luhsana Road. Police said he opened fire when officers attempted to apprehend him and was injured by a bullet in his leg. A pistol and cartridges were allegedly recovered from his possession.

Police are continuing to investigate the alleged conspiracy, the role of the accused and the circumstances leading to Talib’s murder. The allegations against Meena and Asim will be subject to the investigation and judicial proceedings.
